decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's trusted second-channel and binding mobile communication strategy, even though the website no longer highlighted it in 2020 to 2021.
Mobile PDF signing fits the move toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain, though it may be folded into a broader signing offering.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture underpins the integrated security platform and supports the other products, even if it is marketed under different wording.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche feature that has not been visible since 2019, so its resources are better spent on the core identity and secure communication platform.
Payment security compliance remains relevant for regulated customers and builds on existing cryptographic expertise, which justifies keeping it despite lower visibility.
